pattern.title: Use of the METS descriptive metadata section.

rule.assert: CSIP18;ERROR;Mandatory, identifier must be unique within the package.
CSIP19;ERROR;Mandatory, creation date of the descriptive metadata in this section.
CSIP20_1;WARN;SHOULD be used to indicated the status of the package.
CSIP20_2;ERROR;SHOULD be used to indicated the status of the package.
CSIP21;WARN;SHOULD provide a reference to the descriptive metadata file located in the “metadata” section of the IP..
CSIP22;ERROR;The locator type is always used with the value “URL” from the vocabulary in the attribute.
CSIP23;ERROR;Attribute used with the value “simple”. Value list is maintained by the xlink standard.
CSIP24;ERROR;The actual location of the resource. This specification recommends recording a URL type filepath in this attribute.
CSIP25;ERROR;Specifies the type of metadata in the referenced file. Values are taken from the list provided by the METS.
CSIP26;ERROR;MUST hold the IANA mime type of the referenced file.
CSIP27;ERROR;MUST hold the size of the referenced file in bytes.
CSIP28;ERROR;MUST hold the creation date of the referenced file.
CSIP29;ERROR;MUST hold the checksum of the referenced file.
CSIP30;ERROR;MUST hold the algorithm type of checksum of the referenced file.
